class.name: PHASEManager
class.brief_description: Manages the Apple PHASE spatial audio engine.
class.description: Singleton node that manages the lifecycle of Apple's PHASE spatial audio engine. Automatically added to the scene tree by the phasetools editor plugin via [code]PhaseManagerSingleton.gd[/code]. The PHASE engine initializes automatically when this node enters the scene tree. It updates every physics frame while running. Engine-level configuration (such as [member use_client_rendering_mode]) is read from [b]Project > Project Settings[/b] at startup. Enable [b]Advanced Settings[/b] in the Project Settings dialog to browse the [code]phase[/code] category. [b]Note:[/b] Only available on Apple platforms (macOS 15.0+, iOS 18.0+, visionOS 26.0+, tvOS 18.0+).

method.name: initialize_engine
method.description: Starts the PHASE audio engine. Called automatically when the node enters the scene tree. Returns [code]true[/code] on success. Manual calls are only needed if the engine was previously shut down with [method shutdown_engine].

method.name: is_engine_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the PHASE engine is currently running.

method.name: shutdown_engine
method.description: Stops the PHASE engine and releases its resources. Also called automatically when this node is freed.

members.member: The reverb preset applied to the scene. Affects all audio sources that have reverb sends enabled. Defaults to [constant REVERB_PRESET_SMALL_ROOM].

[b]visionOS only.[/b] When [code]true[/code], the PHASE engine is initialized with [code]PHASERenderingModeClient[/code], so audio is rendered through the system for mixed reality scenes that share spatial audio with other apps. When [code]false[/code] (the default), the engine uses [code]PHASERenderingModeLocal[/code] and the app controls its own listener via [PHASEAudioListener3D]. [b]Must be set before the engine initializes.[/b] Configure this via [b]Project > Project Settings > phase/use_client_rendering_mode[/b]. The [code]phase[/code] category is only visible when [b]Advanced Settings[/b] is toggled on in the Project Settings dialog.
